name: grand-keys
description: GrandKeys __ Virtual Grand Piano __ Built with: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Web Audio. - GrandKeys is an interactive virtual piano built with JavaScript, designed to deliver a realistic piano-playing experience directly in the browser. Play individual piano keys using your mouse, keyboard, or touchscreen, with realistic piano sounds and interactive pressed and released key animations. The project features a beautifully designed digital grand piano interface, responsive controls, and an immersive musical experience.
